documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: Your own documents, read aloud: books, letters, papers. Upload them here, give them a title to ask for them by, or tell it which folders and web addresses to look in.
documents.upload.title: Upload a document
documents.upload.name: Title (leave empty to use the one in the document)
documents.list.title: Your documents
documents.list.hint: A title is what you say to hear it: "read me the document …". Clear a title to go back to the document's own.
documents.list.sure: Delete this document from the device?
documents.sources.title: Where to look
documents.sources.folders: Folders on the device, one per line
documents.sources.urls: Web addresses, one per line: a document, or a page that links to documents
documents.ask: Say "read my documents" to hear the newest one.
documents.err.kind: That kind of file cannot be read.
documents.err.upload: The upload did not arrive whole; try again.
documents.err.notmine: Only an uploaded document can be deleted here.
documents.err.url: A web address starts with http:// or https://.
